title.title: Fewer fixed points than the strong Arnold bounds allow
title.subtitle: Claim: a Hamiltonian map of $Q^3$ with 3 fixed points, though every function on $Q^3$ has at least 4 critical points

plain: Arnold said stirring a space fixes as many points as a landscape has peaks and pits; not in the strong form

beats.text: Arnold: a Hamiltonian map should have as many fixed points as a function has critical points
A degenerate counterexample: one fewer fixed point than the critical number
And nondegenerate ones on simply connected Kähler 22-manifolds, short by a fixed fraction

steps: The homological form of Arnold's bound is a theorem, via Floer theory
The stronger form asks for as many fixed points as critical points
On the quadric threefold: 3 fixed points, but every function needs 4

achievement.label: Strong Arnold conjectures: critical number, cup-length, stable Morse
achievement.context: The homological Arnold conjecture, a theorem of Floer theory, is untouched

verify.detail: Lean: only the degenerate quadric example, about 5,900 lines
verify.ourCheck: We read the claims; we did not build the Lean

voice.text: Arnold: a Hamiltonian map fixes as many points as a function has critical points.
Floer theory proves the weak version; here the strong count breaks.
Claimed: three fixed points where functions need four.

sources.quote: The release gives [a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of the complex quadric threefold](https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/A-degenerate-counterexample-to-the-critical-number-Arnold-bound-September-23-2026/paper.pdf) with exactly 3 fixed points, while every smooth function on that manifold has at least 4 critical points, and families of simply connected Kähler 22-manifolds where the nondegenerate fixed-point count falls below the stable Morse number by a fixed fraction (stable Morse number $80 + 1968m$, fixed points $80 + 1952m$). Only the quadric example is in Lean (about 5,900 lines). These refute the strong variants and leave the homological conjecture untouched.
A Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of the complex quadric threefold Q^3 with exactly 3 fixed points < 4 = Crit(Q^3) = rational cup-length
The homological Arnold conjecture is a theorem of Floer theory
